definitions.explanation: A magnificent building, especially a large hall or temple. Used to describe imposing or prestigious buildings.
A figurative or literal place of honor where the greatest figures in a particular field are celebrated. Often used in the expression 殿堂入り (hall of fame induction).

examples.japanese: ⟦{荘厳|そうごん}→荘厳：14754_sougon⟧な{殿堂|でんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A solemn grand hall stands there.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殿堂|でんどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: This museum is called a palace of art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神殿|しんでん}→神殿：18822_shinden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な{殿堂|でんどう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The temples of ancient Greece are known as magnificent halls.

examples.japanese: {殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The hall of fame induction has been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧{殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: He was inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められ→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祝福|しゅくふく}→祝福：13733_shukufuku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The band, whose long years of achievement were recognized with their Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction, was celebrated by fans around the world.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is literary and formal, describing grand buildings. Sense 2 is far more common in modern usage, especially the compound {殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り (hall of fame induction). This expression is used for sports, music, and other fields.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り: hall of fame induction
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殿堂|でんどう}: palace/temple of art
- ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧{殿堂|でんどう}: Baseball Hall of Fame
- {殿堂|でんどう}{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to be inducted into the hall of fame
